prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: A good starting shortlist in Phoenix
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—location, case complexity, cost, and how comfortable you feel with the doctor all matter. **A good starting shortlist in Phoenix** is:

- **Dunn Orthodontics** — says its orthodontists are board-certified and offers braces and Invisalign at several Phoenix-area locations. [Website](https://dunn-orthodontics.com/)
- **Serrano Orthodontics** — board-certified orthodontists; offers braces and Invisalign near central Phoenix. [Website](https://serranoorthodontics.com/)
- **Arizona Orthodontic Studio** — offers traditional braces and Invisalign in Phoenix. [Website](https://azorthostudio.com/)
- **Woolaver Orthodontics** — in Ahwatukee; offers braces and Invisalign, with a strong Invisalign focus. [Website](https://woolaverorthodontics.com/)

If you want one practical first pick, **compare Dunn and Serrano** if board certification and a specialist practice are priorities; consider **Woolaver** if you’re in south Phoenix/Ahwatukee and especially interested in Invisalign. These are starting points, not a definitive ranking.

Book two or three consultations and ask who will personally supervise your treatment, whether braces or aligners suit your bite, what the full fee includes (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies are handled. Check the orthodontist’s credentials and confirm your insurance coverage before committing.
